snippet.title: Valiance Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the Playtest over on Steam or wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664580/Valiance/

Join the Valiance Community: https://discord.com/invite/vE6eFYuKHW


Valiance is a fast paced FPS combining the power fantasy of Boomer Shooters like Doom or Ultrakill with abilities from Hero Shooters like Overwatch.
But you create YOUR OWN CHARACTER by choosing your own set of weapons and abilities.
